instruction: I am throwing a party for all of my coworkers and friends upcoming Sunday night. I need return gifts for them. Buy electric shavers on amazon with at least 4.0 rating, and with 7 or more reviews, one for each invitee, and make sure they reach home by the end of the day before the party.
notes: Two apps are needed besides supervisor: phone (search contacts by relationship to count coworkers and friends; the quantity object quantity-num-invitees stands for the size of the union of both groups, encoded via the static fact (invitee-quantity q coworker friend) so add_product_to_cart requires both searches) and amazon (search electric shavers with min rating 4.0, show_product to verify >= 7 reviews and delivery by 2023-05-27, add the product to the cart with the invitee count and clear_cart_first=true so the order contains only the shavers, look up the home address id and a payment card id, place the order). Task requirements (product type, min rating, min reviews, deadline, home address) are static facts in :init; the knowledge predicates product-matches/product-verified are unary because the actions that assert them are forced to use the required threshold objects. place_order sets the nullary (gifts-ordered) summary fact which is the only task-specific goal condition and the precondition of supervisor-complete-task (no answer needed). Apps are domain constants only (not redeclared in the problem). Current date is Tuesday 2023-05-23, so the party is Sunday 2023-05-28 and delivery must happen by end of 2023-05-27.
